description: Build a ready-made tracker entry for a bonus the person is opening or has opened: the dates that matter (last day to open, finish the requirements by, when the bonus should arrive, when the account can be closed), a link that adds the bonus to their Stack tracker on thebonusstack.com, and a calendar file with those dates. Nothing is saved on our side and no account is needed. The person taps the link to keep it in their own browser. Use it when someone says they opened an account or asks to be reminded of a deadline.

bonus_id.description: The bonus_id from find_bonuses or get_bonus.

opened_on.description: The day the person opened the account, YYYY-MM-DD. Leave it out when they have not opened it yet; the dates then count from today.

option.description: For a bonus with options, the option the person is doing: its offer_id from track_bonus, or its label from get_bonus.

name: track_bonus
title: Give the person a tracker entry and dates for a bonus
